verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS payroll product like RUN, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls, or any opt-out setting. The pages cover payroll, HR, integrations and API Central only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
